* '''Original''' ([[Evacuate? (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011): “Use 1 Force to target your character of ability > 3 alone at a site. USED: During any move phase, take target into hand. LOST: If opponent has exactly one non-spy character at target's site, place target in Used Pile.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 3 June 2011"; copy re-made 25 July 2011), page 3, slip 15 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the original text again; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Evacuate? (V) (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=36, page 36. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=36 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) printed “traget” for “target” (kept as printed): “Use 1 Force to traget your character of ability > 3 alone at a site. USED: During any move phase, take target into hand. LOST: If opponent has exactly one non-spy character at target's site, place target in Used Pile.”<ref name="cl-1273_15-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Evacuate? (V) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-evacuate-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Evacuate? (V)]]) again, word for word: “Use 1 Force to target your character of ability > 3 alone at a site. USED: During any move phase, take target into hand. LOST: If opponent has exactly one non-spy character at target's site, place target in Used Pile.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual7-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual7-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034727/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Evacuate? (V) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 36)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Evacuate? (V)]]) again, word for word: “Use 1 Force to target your character of ability > 3 alone at a site. USED: During any move phase, take target into hand. LOST: If opponent has exactly one non-spy character at target's site, place target in Used Pile.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1273-15-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
